'''''Gagea lacaitae''''' is a [[Mediterranean]] and [[Black Sea]] species of plants in the [[Liliaceae|lily family]]. It is native to [[Spain]] incl. [[Balearic Islands]], [[France]] incl. [[Corsica]], [[Italy]] ([[Abruzzo]] + [[Sicily]]), [[Morocco]], and [[Algeria]].<ref name=kathy>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=307295 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>Tison, J.M. (2009). An update of the genus ''Gagea'' Salisb. (Liliaceae) in the Iberian peninsula. Lagascalia 29: 7-22.</ref>

''Gagea lacaitae'' is a bulb-forming herb with yellow flowers.<ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=gagea+lacaitae Altervista Flora Italiana, Cipollaccio giallo di Lacaita ''Gagea lacaitae'']</ref>

The species is named for British botanist and politician [[Charles Carmichael Lacaita]], 1853–1933.
